volunteer.title: Volunteer suspect
volunteer.consent.title: Volunteer as a suspect
volunteer.consent.content:
For the next {minutes} minutes, police running a tablet mission may ask you to play its suspect instead of an NPC. You get a yes or no question every time and nothing starts without your yes.

- Server rules on force, combat logging and staging apply.
- Crimson-Police gives suspects nothing: no points, cash or items.
- Officers never see your live position.
- Saying yes and then not showing up or walking away is a strike; {strikes} strikes stop you volunteering for a while.
- Use the same command any time to renew or stop.
volunteer.roles.title: Suspects you will play
volunteer.role.runner: The wanted person who runs (on foot)
volunteer.role.driver: The getaway or race driver (your own car)
volunteer.role.fugitive: The fugitive hiding in a search area
volunteer.stop.content: Stop volunteering now? Police can no longer ask you to play a suspect.
volunteer.started: You volunteer as a suspect for {minutes} minutes. Police may send you a question when a mission needs you.
volunteer.renewed: Renewed: you volunteer for another {minutes} minutes.
volunteer.roles_saved: Your choice of suspects is saved.
volunteer.strike: Strike {count} of {max}: you said yes and did not play it out.
volunteer.ended.expired: Your volunteer time is over. Use the command again to volunteer.
volunteer.ended.on_duty: You went on police duty, so you no longer volunteer as a suspect.
volunteer.ended.excluded: Staff excluded you from playing suspects, so you no longer volunteer.
volunteer.ended.strikes: Too many strikes: you can't volunteer for a while.
volunteer.ended.disabled: Volunteering was turned off by the server.
volunteer.refused.off: Volunteering as a suspect is not available on this server.
volunteer.refused.in_case: You are already a suspect in a case.
volunteer.refused.instance: You can't volunteer from inside an instance.
volunteer.refused.arena_flag: You can't volunteer while in the arena.
volunteer.refused.on_duty: Police on duty can't volunteer as suspects.
volunteer.refused.job_hop: You were on police duty too recently to volunteer.
volunteer.refused.afk: You look AFK. Move around, then try again.
volunteer.refused.admin: Server admins can't volunteer as suspects.
volunteer.refused.excluded: You are excluded from playing suspects.
volunteer.refused.blocked: Too many strikes: you can volunteer again in about {hours} h.
volunteer.refused.no_role: Pick at least one suspect to play.
volunteer.refused.not_listed: You are not volunteering right now.
board.locked_real_suspect: {type}: these missions are played against a real player. Tick Real suspect OK to take them.
board.locked_no_volunteer: No volunteer suspect is free for {type} right now
err.real_suspect_needed: These missions are played against a real player: tick Real suspect OK to take them.
err.volunteer_none: No volunteer suspect who fits is free right now.
err.mc_push_volunteer: That mission is played only against a volunteer suspect, so it can't be pushed.
err.setting_volunteer_type: Each key must be a mission type in Config.MissionTypes (such as patrol or tactical).
health.volunteers.ok: Volunteer suspects: {n} missions may be played against a volunteer
health.volunteers.unknown: Config.Volunteers names {key}, which is no mission type or mission: ignored
health.volunteers.bad_mode: Config.Volunteers sets {key} to '{mode}', which is not npc, players_when_available or players_only: it plays the NPC
health.volunteers.no_slot: {key} is set to players_when_available, but none of its missions has a suspect a volunteer can play: it keeps playing the NPC
health.volunteers.no_slot_only: {key} is set to players_only, but none of its missions has a suspect a volunteer can play: it is never offered
volunteer.ask.title: Play a suspect now?
volunteer.ask.content:
Police took a mission and you can play its suspect: {role}.

The starting point is about {km} km from you; you have {minutes} minutes to get there once you say yes (it becomes your map waypoint). Saying yes and then not showing up or walking away is a strike. Saying no costs nothing.

This question closes in {seconds} seconds.
volunteer.ask.content_near:
Police took a mission and you can play its suspect: {role}.

You have {minutes} minutes to reach the starting point once you say yes (it becomes your map waypoint). Saying yes and then not showing up or walking away is a strike. Saying no costs nothing.

This question closes in {seconds} seconds.
volunteer.ask.accepted: You play the suspect. Head to your waypoint.
volunteer.ask.declined: No problem: you stay on the list.
volunteer.ask.too_late: Too late: the question had closed.
volunteer.ask.not_now: You can't play this suspect any more, so someone else is asked. You stay on the list.
volunteer.case.travel: Reach your waypoint within {minutes} min and wait there in character.
volunteer.case.in_position: You are in position. Police are on their way.
volunteer.case.engaged: Police have reached you: play it out. Server rules on force and combat logging apply.
volunteer.case.released: The case is over: you are free to go. Thanks for playing.
volunteer.case.no_show: You did not reach the starting point in time: the case went on without you.
volunteer.case.void: Your part in the case was called off.
volunteer.case.afk: You were caught while away from the keyboard: your part in the case is void.
volunteer.case.out_warn: You are outside the search area (the red circle on your map). Get back inside within {seconds} s or your part is void.
volunteer.case.out_of_bounds: You stayed outside the search area: your part in the case is void.
volunteer.cancel.content: Stop playing this suspect now? Right after your yes it is free; later, or once police reached you, it is a strike.
volunteer.refused.no_case: You are not playing a suspect right now.
volunteer.officer.yes: A volunteer plays this mission's suspect: a real player. Treat him like any suspect on the street.
volunteer.officer.npc: No volunteer plays this mission's suspect: an NPC plays him.
volunteer.officer.void_end: The volunteer suspect dropped out, so this mission ends.
